description: Screen of 24 negation-style questions written from prohibition sentences in the corpus, to look for a negation rescue. Retrieval only (no LLM). A candidate needs the target chunk at baseline rank 4-10 and re-ranked rank 1-3. All candidates are listed, including those that failed.
